templates.name: Straight Tunnel (3‑Wide Approach)
notes: Three‑Wide Law: lane depth ≥3 maintained behind door.
Stamping: map '.'→walkable; 'D'→walkable with flags.DOOR_BAND and mark interior approach cells with flags.APPROACH3W; '#'→rock; 'O'→rock with flags.ORE_PREF.
Door alignment: corridor digger centers on the middle 'D'. The provided doors[].cells are authoritative in unrotated orientation; engine must rotate these when stamping rotated variants.
